description: Predicted AP score from 1 to 5 using the page bands on the weighted composite percent: multiple choice and free response contributions are weighted by the exam split, then banded at 70, 55, 40, and 25 percent. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive AP Exam Score calculator.

mc_weight_pct.description: Multiple choice weight percent for the exam (the page presets are 50, 40, 45, and 60 depending on the exam); default 50.
